fields.status: Active; v0.4.4 was released 2026-08-02 and the repository continued to receive changes through 2026-10-15. Box64 translates x86-64 Linux user-space code for non-x86 Linux hosts, especially ARM64, with documented RISC-V and LoongArch support; it does not emulate a full computer.
fields.strategy: x86-64 Linux user-mode ISA translation using native host libraries
fields.subtype: CPU binary translator (process-level; not full-system emulation)

sources.label: Box64 README: host architectures, user-mode scope, and native-library approach

fields.status: Active; FEX-2610 was released 2026-10-07 and the repository continued to receive changes through 2026-10-13. It translates x86/x86-64 Linux user-mode applications to ARM64 Linux; it is not a Windows API layer or a full-system emulator.
fields.strategy: x86/x86-64 Linux user-mode ISA translation to ARM64
fields.subtype: CPU binary translator (process-level; not full-system emulation)
